About the RAR Richmond Monday Night Ride group ride

The Richmond chapter of Radical Adventure Riders runs a Monday night city and mountain bike ride. The group centers femme, trans, women and non-binary riders and prioritizes BIPOC and queer access. Beginner-friendly, with mechanical workshops and bike access regardless of income. Check Instagram for the week's start.
